description: Source file defining the ModelTranslator class within the Goteo project. It handles translation-related database operations for various models, including fetching fields, retrieving translations, saving and deleting translation entries, and managing translation metadata.

classes.name: ModelTranslator
classes.description: Handles translation operations for models, including retrieving fields, managing translations, and interfacing with database tables related to translations.

methods.name: getTableFromZone
methods.description: Determines the database table name for a given zone (model alias), considering forced mappings and class existence.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of translatable fields for a specific zone/model, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves ordering preferences for a specific zone/model.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a single translation model record by ID, including translation metadata.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of translation records with filtering and translation status indicators.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves the translation of a specific field for a given language, respecting original language settings.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the translation content (e.g., markdown, html, plain).

methods.name: isOriginal
methods.description: Checks if a given language is the original language of the record.

methods.name: isTranslated
methods.description: Checks if a given language has a translation for the record.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if a given language's translation is pending approval.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a translation for a specific language from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates translation data for a specific language, handling inserts or updates accordingly.
